title: What's new in {{version}}
intro: A few changes worth knowing about:
items: Added Ukrainian localization for races, classes, backgrounds, and equipment — character traits and features now display in Ukrainian.
Fixed inconsistent Ukrainian naming for two class/race terms (Artificer, Halfling).
Removed a confusing block from the GM home screen and fixed the "Start Encounter Prep" and "Campaign Notes" buttons, which sometimes opened the wrong screen.
Fixed a "Campaign not found" error that could appear when opening a campaign from the list.
The sync status block on the Home and GM screens now only appears when there's actually something to report, instead of always showing.
Fixed a translation bug and made character cards easier to read on the Shared Updates screen.
Sped up the first time you open the Bestiary, Spellbook, or a character sheet in a session — less of a "frozen" feeling.
